summary: Add an exact signed-symplectic nested-relay lemma, a reflection-pair diagnostic, and a precise no-conjugate-point/global-order obligation while keeping universal multiphase O3a open.

node.title: Symplectic Jacobi and reflection identities for the nested relay map
node.statement: The accepted full-relay reduction, direct Hamiltonian-saltation algebra, homogeneity, symplectic conservation, simple terminal zeros, relay energy, and reflection imply the Jacobi derivative, conjugate-point, and reflected-pair identities in CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-SYMPLECTIC-NESTED.

node.title: Exact symplectic nested-relay reduction and reflection diagnostic
node.statement: Fix finite R>1, n>=2, either saturation sign, and a premise-complete transverse full-relay trajectory with parameters (mu,q), q>1, whose indexed zero times coincide at L. Write p=U_t(L), r=V_t(L), A_n=T_U^n-T_V^(n+1), and let eta=partial_q(U,U_t,V,V_t) at fixed time, including exact saltation corrections. Then -p eta_U(L)+r eta_V(L)=0 and partial_q A_n=(1-q^2)eta_U(L)/(p r^2); hence partial_q A_n=0 exactly when the q-Jacobi field vanishes in both terminal position components. Reflection sends q to q_sharp=abs(r)/abs(p), preserves mu, sign, indexed phases, event count and the integral ratio, and satisfies q_sharp^2-1=(q^2-1)/p^2. Its fixed points obey q_sharp=q iff p^2=1 iff r^2=q^2, in which case cellwise relay uniqueness makes the trajectory reflection invariant. These are exact reductions; they do not prove global no-conjugate-points, fixed-mu uniqueness, or universal O3a.

node.title: Exclude q-Jacobi conjugate points and close the invariant norm residual
node.statement: Prove a global fixed-mu uniqueness or no-conjugate-point theorem for the common-terminal equation A_n(mu,q)=0 in every premise-complete relay chamber, then prove the reflection-invariant norm residual has exactly one zero across all chamber closures; alternatively certify a distinct reflected root pair.
node.formal_statement: For every finite R>1, n>=2 and max/min sign, show that the q-Jacobi field cannot have eta_U(L)=eta_V(L)=0 at a common indexed terminal point and upgrade the resulting local order to a global one-root theorem for A_n, together with one zero of C_n=log(I_U/I_V); or provide two interval-certified premise-complete reflected roots.
discharge_criteria: Cover every finite R>1, every n>=2, both saturation signs, all premise-complete relay chambers, and compatible chamber closures.
Do not infer symmetry from reversibility alone or global uniqueness from a merely local nonzero derivative.
A counterexample route must certify two distinct complete roots or a singular root with a bifurcation witness, including all terminal, event, positivity, indexing, and equal-integral premises.

node.title: Symplectic nested-relay and full asymmetric counterexample route
node.statement: Use the signed-symplectic hybrid variational flow and reflection involution to isolate the single q-Jacobi conjugate-point obstruction, while independently searching the unrestricted two-scalar relay system for a premise-complete reflected root pair.
node.method_family: Signed-symplectic Jacobi fields, reflection involution, nested zero-time residuals, deterministic full-relay multistart, and interval-certificate escalation
node.deliverable_contract: An exact no-conjugate-point/global order theorem, a unique invariant norm-residual zero, a premise-complete certified reflected root pair, or a precise audited stopping condition.
falsification_tests: Check fixed-time versus moving-terminal derivatives and include every saltation correction.
Do not infer symmetry from the finite observation p^2 approximately 1 on sampled A_n roots.
Reject small residuals with the wrong 2n event count or failed energy identity.
Treat finite mu/q caps, failed optimization, and no-found-root cases as non-exclusion.
node.expected_bottleneck: A global hybrid no-conjugate-point theorem and global one-root count across changing relay chambers; finite scans cannot exclude disconnected reflected pairs.

rationale.scope: The exact identities reduce one nested derivative to a hybrid conjugate-point obstruction and characterize reflection-fixed common-terminal trajectories. They do not prove global injectivity, symmetry, uniqueness, or the max/min target.
rationale.computation_policy: The 36-case full-relay scan, selected n=5,6 cases, and 13 common-terminal probes are finite binary64 discovery evidence only. They are not proposed as truth-propagating numerical results and no counterexample candidate survived premise checks.

math_premise_contracts.scope: All finite R>1, n>=2, both signs, arbitrary asymmetric premise-complete full-relay trajectories and their chamberwise two-scalar residuals.
math_premise_contracts.contract_explanation: The new lemma starts only on the accepted common-terminal subset and does not silently add reflection symmetry or norm equality.

math_premise_contracts.scope: Positive box-constrained weighted Dirichlet strings and consecutive indexed eigenmodes.
math_premise_contracts.contract_explanation: The relay state and terminal phases use the canonical weighted-string normalization and indexing.

math_premise_contracts.scope: Max/min saturation, exactly 2n effective switches, and a.e. equivalence.
math_premise_contracts.contract_explanation: Reflection preserves the sign class and point values at switches remain irrelevant.

ordered_steps: Write the max/min relay as a continuous homogeneous piecewise-quadratic Hamiltonian for omega=dU wedge dP-dV wedge dQ.
Derive the exact transverse saltation matrix and verify directly that both it and every constant-cell flow preserve omega.

Use state homogeneity to identify xi=z as a hybrid Jacobi field and pair it symplectically with the fixed-time q-sensitivity eta, yielding -p eta_U(L)+r eta_V(L)=0 at a double Dirichlet terminal point.
Differentiate the two simple indexed terminal zero times and combine the pairing with p^2-r^2=1-q^2 to obtain partial_q A_n=(1-q^2)eta_U(L)/(p r^2) and the exact conjugate-point equivalence.
Reflect and positively reorient the terminal trajectory, compute q_sharp=abs(r)/abs(p), show both relay integrals scale by p^(-2), and derive q_sharp^2-1=(q^2-1)/p^2.
Use q>1 and relay IVP uniqueness to identify the fixed-point conditions q_sharp=q, p^2=1, r^2=q^2 and their reflection-symmetry consequence.
boundary_cases: Every n>=2 and both signs are covered on premise-complete transverse common-terminal chambers.
R=1, R=infinity, grazing away from roots, and non-simple terminal zeros are not silently included.
Fixed-time sensitivities are kept distinct from moving terminal-time derivatives.
Reversibility is not promoted to uniqueness, and local nondegeneracy is not promoted to a global root count.
The finite computations motivating the route are not used in the proof.

math_research_state_records.status_justification: The exact derivative formula isolates the q-Jacobi conjugate point, but no global no-conjugate-point theorem, all-chamber order theorem, or unique norm-residual zero is proved. The obligation is strictly weaker than the max/min synthesis only when both required clauses are discharged.
The route produced a proved exact partial lemma and finite non-certifying searches with no distinct reflected pair. Universal O3a and both branch inferences remain open.
